name: raymarched-blob
prompt: Raymarched metaball blob that slowly morphs, lit with a key light and a rim light. Use a hit struct for the march result.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote a shader layer: five spheres blend together into one slowly changing blob, rendered with raymarching. Each march returns a `Hit` struct (`hit`, `t`, `pos`, `steps`). It's lit by a warm key light with a highlight and a cyan back rim light. Speed, blend, size, colors, light strengths and rim falloff are Inspector controls. I couldn't compile or render it because no Powermove tools were attached this run.
